game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep firewood safe from yeti raiders.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep firewood safe from yeti raiders. Each round, yeti raiders strike the hearth fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the scope_safe value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hearth fire from yeti raiders in Snow Fort: keep the scope_safe meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: scope_safe drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Scope Sanctuary' (Week 6 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how scope_safe changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while scope_safe > 0.
